//-*****************************************************************************
void register_isampleselector()
{
    // ISampleSelector
    //
    scope ss =
         class_<Abc::ISampleSelector>(
             "ISampleSelector",
             "The ISampleSelector utilize the selection of the sample index "
             "for the initialized requested index or time",
             init<AbcA::index_t>(
                 ( arg( "requestedIndex" ) ),
                 "Create an ISampleSelector with the given requested index") )
        .def( init<AbcA::chrono_t,
              optional<Abc::ISampleSelector::TimeIndexType> >(
                  ( arg( "requestedTime" ),
                    arg( "requestedIndexType ") ),
                  "Create an ISampleSelector with the given requested time and "
                  " the optional request index type" ) )
        .def( init<>(
                  "Create an ISampleSelector with the requested index value of "
                  "0 and the requested index type of kNearIndex" ) )
        .def( "getIndex",
              &Abc::ISampleSelector::getIndex,
              ( arg( "timeSampling" ), arg( "numSamples" ) ),
              "Return the requested index with the given time sampling and "
              "the number of samples" )
        .def( "getRequestedIndex",
              &Abc::ISampleSelector::getRequestedIndex,
              "Return the requested Index" )
        .def( "getRequestedTime",
              &Abc::ISampleSelector::getRequestedTime,
              "Return the requested time" )
        .def( "getRequestedTimeIndexType",
              &Abc::ISampleSelector::getRequestedTimeIndexType,
              "Return the requested time index type" )
        ;
    // Implicit conversions for ISampleSelector
    //
    implicitly_convertible<AbcA::index_t, Abc::ISampleSelector>();
    implicitly_convertible<AbcA::chrono_t, Abc::ISampleSelector>();
   
    // TimeIndexType
    //
    enum_<Abc::ISampleSelector::TimeIndexType>( "TimeIndexType" )
        .value( "kFloorIndex", Abc::ISampleSelector::kFloorIndex )
        .value( "kCeilIndex", Abc::ISampleSelector::kCeilIndex )
        .value( "kNearIndex", Abc::ISampleSelector::kNearIndex )
        ;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <stack>
using namespace std;
int main(){
    stack<int> s; // stack of integers
    stack<int> s1; // default constructor
    stack<int> s2(s1); // copy constructor independent of s1
    s.push(1); // push 1 onto the stack
    s.push(2); // push 2 onto the stack
    s.push(3); // push 3 onto the stack
    s.push(4); // push 4 onto the stack
    s.emplace(5); // emplace 5 onto the stack (in-place object creation)
    s.emplace(6); // emplace 6 onto the stack (in-place object creation)
    s1.push(7); // push 7 onto the stack s1
    s1.push(8); // push 8 onto the stack s1
    s1.push(9); // push 9 onto the stack s1
    s1.push(10); // push 10 onto the stack s1
    s2.swap(s1); // swap the contents of s and s1 both exchange their contents
    cout << "s1: " << s1.top() << endl; // print the top element of s1 (10)
    cout << "s1 size: " << s1.size() << endl; // print the size of s1 (4)
    cout << "s2: " << s2.top() << endl; // print the top element of s2 (7)
    s.pop(); // pop the top element (6) from the stack
    cout << "Top element: " << s.top() << endl; // print the top element (5)
    cout << "Size of stack: " << s.size() << endl; // print the size of the stack (5)
    cout << "Is stack empty? " << (s.empty() ? "Yes" : "No") << endl; // check if the stack is empty
    while(!s.empty()) { // while the stack is not empty
        cout << s.top() << " "; // print the top element
        s.pop(); // pop the top element
    }
    cout << endl; // print a newline
    cout << "Size of stack after popping all elements: " << s.size() << endl; // print the size of the stack (0)
    
   
    return 0;
}

namespace py = pybind11;
void register_cmath(py::module& m) {
    // CMathFunction enum
    py::enum_<sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction>(m, "CMathFunction")
        // Trigonometric functions
        .value("sin", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::sin)
        .value("cos", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::cos)
        .value("tan", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::tan)
        .value("asin", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::asin)
        .value("acos", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::acos)
        .value("atan", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::atan)
        .value("atan2", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::atan2)
        // Hyperbolic functions
        .value("sinh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::sinh)
        .value("cosh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::cosh)
        .value("tanh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::tanh)
        .value("asinh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::asinh)
        .value("acosh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::acosh)
        .value("atanh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::atanh)
        // Exponential and logarithmic functions
        .value("exp", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::exp)
        .value("exp2", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::exp2)
        .value("exp10", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::exp10)
        .value("expm1", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::expm1)
        .value("log", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log)
        .value("log10", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log10)
        .value("log2", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log2)
        .value("log1p", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log1p)
        // Power functions
        .value("pow", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::pow)
        .value("sqrt", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::sqrt)
        .value("cbrt", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::cbrt)
        .value("hypot", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::hypot)
        // Error and gamma functions
        .value("erf", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::erf)
        .value("erfc", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::erfc)
        .value("tgamma", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::tgamma)
        .value("lgamma", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::lgamma)
        // Rounding and remainder functions
        .value("fabs", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fabs)
        .value("ceil", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::ceil)
        .value("floor", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::floor)
        .value("trunc", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::trunc)
        .value("round", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::round)
        .value("lround", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::lround)
        .value("llround", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::llround)
        .value("roundeven", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::roundeven)
        .value("nearbyint", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::nearbyint)
        .value("rint", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::rint)
        .value("lrint", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::lrint)
        .value("llrint", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::llrint)
        .value("fmod", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fmod)
        .value("remainder", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::remainder)
        // Floating-point manipulation functions
        .value("frexp", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::frexp)
        .value("ldexp", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::ldexp)
        .value("modf", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::modf)
        .value("scalbn", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::scalbn)
        .value("scalbln", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::scalbln)
        .value("ilogb", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::ilogb)
        .value("logb", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::logb)
        .value("nextafter", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::nextafter)
        .value("nexttoward", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::nexttoward)
        .value("copysign", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::copysign)
        // Minimum, maximum, difference functions
        .value("fmax", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fmax)
        .value("fmin", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fmin)
        .value("fdim", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fdim)
        // Other functions
        .value("fma", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fma)
        .export_values();
}

void register_filmbackxformop()
{
    // FilmBackXformOp
    //
    class_<AbcG::FilmBackXformOp>(
          "FilmBackXformOp",
          "This class holds the data about a particular transform operation, but does "
          "not hold the actual data to calculate a 3x3 matrix.  It holds the type of "
          "operation (Translate, Scale, Matrix), a hint about the type which "
          "can be interpreted by packages like Maya, and what particular parts of the "
          "operations can change over time.",
         init<const AbcG::FilmBackXformOperationType, const std::string&>(
             ( arg( "type" ), arg( "hint" ) = 0 ),
             "Create an FilmBackXformOp with default settings based on the type of operation "
             "and a hint about the type for applications like Maya." ) )
        .def( init<>("Create an empty FilmBackXformOp" ) )
        .def( "getType",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getType,
              "Get the type of transform operation. (Translate, Scale, "
              "Matrix)")
        .def( "getHint",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getHint,
              "Get the Hint to help "
              "disambiguate certain options that may have the same type.")
        .def( "getTypeHint",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getHint,
              "Get the type and hint, where the first character is the type"
              "(t for translate, s for scale, m for matrix) and the rest of the"
              "returned string is the optional hint value." )
        .def( "getNumChannels",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getNumChannels,
              "Get the number of components that this operation has based on the type. "
              "Translate and Scale have 2 and Matrix has 9." )
        .def( "getChannelValue", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getChannelValue,
              ( arg( "index" ) ),
              "Get a single channel, 0 will be returned if iIndex is greater than"
              "numChannels - 1" )
        .def( "setChannelValue",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setChannelValue,
              ( arg( "index" ), arg( "value" ) ),
              "Set a single channel; nothing will be set if iIndex is greater than"
              "numchannels - 1.")
        .def( "setTranslate", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setTranslate,
              ( arg( "trans" ) ) )
        .def( "setScale", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setScale,
              ( arg( "scale" ) ) )
        .def( "setMatrix", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setMatrix,
              ( arg( "matrix" ) ) )
        .def( "getTranslate", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getTranslate )
        .def( "getScale", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getScale )
        .def( "getMatrix", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getMatrix )
        .def( "isTranslateOp", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isTranslateOp )
        .def( "isScaleOp", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isScaleOp )
        .def( "isMatrixOp", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isMatrixOp )
        ;
}

// Checks if type T is convertible to any integer type (excluding char and bool types)
template <typename T>
struct is_convertible_to_int 
    : boost::mpl::and_<
        boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, bool>>,
        boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, char>>,
        boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, unsigned char>>,
        boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, signed char>>,
        boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, wchar_t>>,
        boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, char16_t>>,
        boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, char32_t>>,
        boost::mpl::or_<
            boost::is_convertible<T, int>,
            boost::is_convertible<T, unsigned int>,
            boost::is_convertible<T, long>,
            boost::is_convertible<T, unsigned long>,
            boost::is_convertible<T, long long>,
            boost::is_convertible<T, unsigned long long>
        >
    > {};

  ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(U(0,0)=Su11.f;)                                      ENABLE_SSE_IMPLEMENTATION(_mm_storeu_ps(u11,Vu11);)                                 ENABLE_AVX_IMPLEMENTATION(_mm256_storeu_ps(u11,Vu11);)

// Register CMathFunction enum to Python module
void register_cmath(py::module& m)
{
    // CMathFunction enum
    py::enum_<sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction>(m, "CMathFunction")
        // Trigonometric functions
        .value("sin", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::sin)
        .value("cos", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::cos)
        .value("tan", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::tan)
        .value("asin", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::asin)
        .value("acos", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::acos)
        .value("atan", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::atan)
        .value("atan2", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::atan2)
        // Hyperbolic functions
        .value("sinh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::sinh)
        .value("cosh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::cosh)
        .value("tanh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::tanh)
        .value("asinh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::asinh)
        .value("acosh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::acosh)
        .value("atanh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::atanh)
        // Exponential and logarithmic functions
        .value("exp", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::exp)
        .value("exp2", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::exp2)
        .value("exp10", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::exp10)
        .value("expm1", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::expm1)
        .value("log", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log)
        .value("log10", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log10)
        .value("log2", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log2)
        .value("log1p", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log1p)
        // Power functions
        .value("pow", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::pow)
        .value("sqrt", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::sqrt)
        .value("cbrt", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::cbrt)
        .value("hypot", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::hypot)
        // Error and gamma functions
        .value("erf", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::erf)
        .value("erfc", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::erfc)
        .value("tgamma", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::tgamma)
        .value("lgamma", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::lgamma)
        // Rounding and remainder functions
        .value("fabs", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fabs)
        .value("ceil", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::ceil)
        .value("floor", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::floor)
        .value("trunc", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::trunc)
        .value("round", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::round)
        .value("lround", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::lround)
        .value("llround", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::llround)
        .value("roundeven", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::roundeven)
        .value("nearbyint", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::nearbyint)
        .value("rint", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::rint)
        .value("lrint", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::lrint)
        .value("llrint", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::llrint)
        .value("fmod", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fmod)
        .value("remainder", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::remainder)
        // Floating-point manipulation functions
        .value("frexp", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::frexp)
        .value("ldexp", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::ldexp)
        .value("modf", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::modf)
        .value("scalbn", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::scalbn)
        .value("scalbln", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::scalbln)
        .value("ilogb", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::ilogb)
        .value("logb", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::logb)
        .value("nextafter", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::nextafter)
        .value("nexttoward", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::nexttoward)
        .value("copysign", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::copysign)
        // Minimum, maximum, difference functions
        .value("fmax", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fmax)
        .value("fmin", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fmin)
        .value("fdim", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fdim)
        // Other functions
        .value("fma", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::fma)
        .export_values();
}

void register_filmbackxformop()
{
    // FilmBackXformOp registration
    //
    class_<AbcG::FilmBackXformOp>(
          "FilmBackXformOp",
          "This class holds the data about a particular transform operation, but does "
          "not hold the actual data to calculate a 3x3 matrix.  It holds the type of "
          "operation (Translate, Scale, Matrix), a hint about the type which "
          "can be interpreted by packages like Maya, and what particular parts of the "
          "operations can change over time.",
         init<const AbcG::FilmBackXformOperationType, const std::string&>(
             ( arg( "type" ), arg( "hint" ) = 0 ),
             "Create an FilmBackXformOp with default settings based on the type of operation "
             "and a hint about the type for applications like Maya." ) )
        .def( init<>( "Create an empty FilmBackXformOp" ) )
        .def( "getType",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getType,
              "Get the type of transform operation. (Translate, Scale, "
              "Matrix)")
        .def( "getHint",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getHint,
              "Get the Hint to help "
              "disambiguate certain options that may have the same type.")
        .def( "getTypeHint",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getHint,
              "Get the type and hint, where the first character is the type"
              "(t for translate, s for scale, m for matrix) and the rest of the"
              "returned string is the optional hint value." )
        .def( "getNumChannels",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getNumChannels,
              "Get the number of components that this operation has based on the type. "
              "Translate and Scale have 2 and Matrix has 9." )
        .def( "getChannelValue", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getChannelValue,
              ( arg( "index" ) ),
              "Get a single channel, 0 will be returned if iIndex is greater than"
              "numChannels - 1" )
        .def( "setChannelValue",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setChannelValue,
              ( arg( "index" ), arg( "value" ) ),
              "Set a single channel; nothing will be set if iIndex is greater than"
              "numchannels - 1.")
        .def( "setTranslate", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setTranslate,
              ( arg( "trans" ) ) )
        .def( "setScale", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setScale,
              ( arg( "scale" ) ) )
        .def( "setMatrix", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setMatrix,
              ( arg( "matrix" ) ) )
        .def( "getTranslate", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getTranslate )
        .def( "getScale", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getScale )
        .def( "getMatrix", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getMatrix )
        .def( "isTranslateOp", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isTranslateOp )
        .def( "isScaleOp", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isScaleOp )
        .def( "isMatrixOp", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isMatrixOp )
        ;
}

// Custom type trait to check if T is convertible to any integer type (excluding character and boolean types)
template <typename T>
struct is_integer_convertible : boost::mpl::and_<
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, bool>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, char>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, unsigned char>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, signed char>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, wchar_t>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, char16_t>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, char32_t>>,
    boost::mpl::or_<
        boost::is_convertible<T, int>,
        boost::is_convertible<T, unsigned int>,
        boost::is_convertible<T, long>,
        boost::is_convertible<T, unsigned long>,
        boost::is_convertible<T, long long>,
        boost::is_convertible<T, unsigned long long>
    >
> {};

//-*****************************************************************************
void register_sample_selector()
{
    // ISampleSelector registration
    //
    scope selectorScope =
         class_<Abc::ISampleSelector>(
             "ISampleSelector",
             "The ISampleSelector is used for selecting the sample index "
             "based on either a specified index or time value",
             init<AbcA::index_t>(
                 ( arg( "sampleIndex" ) ),
                 "Construct an ISampleSelector with a specific sample index") )
        .def( init<AbcA::chrono_t,
              optional<Abc::ISampleSelector::TimeIndexType> >(
                  ( arg( "timeValue" ),
                    arg( "indexMode ") ),
                  "Construct an ISampleSelector using a time value and "
                  "an optional time index mode" ) )
        .def( init<>(
                  "Construct an ISampleSelector with default parameters: "
                  "index 0 and kNearIndex mode" ) )
        .def( "computeIndex",
              &Abc::ISampleSelector::getIndex,
              ( arg( "samplingInfo" ), arg( "totalSamples" ) ),
              "Compute and return the effective sample index given the time sampling "
              "and total number of available samples" )
        .def( "requestedIndex",
              &Abc::ISampleSelector::getRequestedIndex,
              "Return the originally requested index value" )
        .def( "requestedTimeValue",
              &Abc::ISampleSelector::getRequestedTime,
              "Return the originally requested time value" )
        .def( "timeIndexMode",
              &Abc::ISampleSelector::getRequestedTimeIndexType,
              "Return the time index selection mode that was requested" )
        ;
    
    // Enable automatic conversion from index and time types to ISampleSelector
    //
    implicitly_convertible<AbcA::index_t, Abc::ISampleSelector>();
    implicitly_convertible<AbcA::chrono_t, Abc::ISampleSelector>();
   
    // TimeIndexType enumeration
    //
    enum_<Abc::ISampleSelector::TimeIndexType>( "TimeIndexType" )
        .value( "kFloorIndex", Abc::ISampleSelector::kFloorIndex )
        .value( "kCeilIndex", Abc::ISampleSelector::kCeilIndex )
        .value( "kNearIndex", Abc::ISampleSelector::kNearIndex )
        ;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <stack>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    stack<int> myStack; // stack of integers
    stack<int> emptyStack; // default constructor
    stack<int> copiedStack(emptyStack); // copy constructor independent of emptyStack
    myStack.push(1); // push 1 onto the stack
    myStack.push(2); // push 2 onto the stack
    myStack.push(3); // push 3 onto the stack
    myStack.push(4); // push 4 onto the stack
    myStack.emplace(5); // emplace 5 onto the stack (in-place object creation)
    myStack.emplace(6); // emplace 6 onto the stack (in-place object creation)
    emptyStack.push(7); // push 7 onto the stack emptyStack
    emptyStack.push(8); // push 8 onto the stack emptyStack
    emptyStack.push(9); // push 9 onto the stack emptyStack
    emptyStack.push(10); // push 10 onto the stack emptyStack
    copiedStack.swap(emptyStack); // swap the contents of myStack and emptyStack both exchange their contents
    cout << "emptyStack top: " << emptyStack.top() << endl; // print the top element of emptyStack (10)
    cout << "emptyStack size: " << emptyStack.size() << endl; // print the size of emptyStack (4)
    cout << "copiedStack top: " << copiedStack.top() << endl; // print the top element of copiedStack (7)
    myStack.pop(); // pop the top element (6) from the stack
    cout << "Current top: " << myStack.top() << endl; // print the top element (5)
    cout << "Remaining elements: " << myStack.size() << endl; // print the size of the stack (5)
    cout << "Is stack empty? " << (myStack.empty() ? "Yes" : "No") << endl; // check if the stack is empty
    while(!myStack.empty()) { // while the stack is not empty
        cout << myStack.top() << " "; // print the top element
        myStack.pop(); // pop the top element
    }
    cout << endl; // print a newline
    cout << "Size after clearing stack: " << myStack.size() << endl; // print the size of the stack (0)
    
    return 0;
}

void register_cmath(py::module& module) {
    // CMathFunction enumeration binding
    py::enum_<sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction>(module, "CMathFunction")
        // Trigonometric operations
        .value("sin", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::sin)
        .value("cos", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::cos)
        .value("tan", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::tan)
        .value("asin", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::asin)
        .value("acos", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::acos)
        .value("atan", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::atan)
        .value("atan2", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::atan2)
        // Hyperbolic operations
        .value("sinh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::sinh)
        .value("cosh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::cosh)
        .value("tanh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::tanh)
        .value("asinh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::asinh)
        .value("acosh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::acosh)
        .value("atanh", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::atanh)
        // Exponential and logarithmic operations
        .value("exp", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::exp)
        .value("exp2", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::exp2)
        .value("exp10", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::exp10)
        .value("expm1", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::expm1)
        .value("log", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log)
        .value("log10", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log10)
        .value("log2", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log2)
        .value("log1p", sdfg::math::cmath::CMathFunction::log1p)
        // Power operations

void register_filmbackxformop()
{
    // FilmBackXformOp
    //
    class_<AbcG::FilmBackXformOp>(
          "FilmBackXformOp",
          "This class stores information regarding a specific transformation operation, "
          "without containing the actual data needed to compute a 3x3 matrix. It specifies "
          "the kind of operation (Translate, Scale, Matrix), an optional hint for tools like Maya, "
          "and indicates which aspects may vary over time.",
         init<const AbcG::FilmBackXformOperationType, const std::string&>(
             ( arg( "operation_type" ), arg( "hint_string" ) = "" ),
             "Constructs a FilmBackXformOp with default settings based on the operation type "
             "and an optional hint string for applications such as Maya." ) )
        .def( init<>("Creates an uninitialized FilmBackXformOp" ) )
        .def( "getOperationType",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getType,
              "Retrieves the type of transformation operation. (Translate, Scale, "
              "Matrix)")
        .def( "getHintString",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getHint,
              "Retrieves the hint used to distinguish between variations of the same operation type.")
        .def( "getFullTypeHint",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getHint,
              "Returns combined type and hint: first character is the operation type "
              "(t=translate, s=scale, m=matrix), followed by the optional hint value." )
        .def( "componentCount",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getNumChannels,
              "Returns the number of components associated with this operation: "
              "2 for Translate/Scale, 9 for Matrix." )
        .def( "getValueAt", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getChannelValue,
              ( arg( "channel_index" ) ),
              "Fetches a single channel value; returns 0 if channel_index exceeds numChannels - 1" )
        .def( "setValueAt",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setChannelValue,
              ( arg( "channel_index" ), arg( "new_value" ) ),
              "Assigns a value to a specific channel; no action taken if channel_index exceeds numChannels - 1.")
        .def( "assignTranslation", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setTranslate,
              ( arg( "translation_vector" ) ) )
        .def( "assignScaling", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setScale,
              ( arg( "scaling_vector" ) ) )
        .def( "assignTransformationMatrix", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setMatrix,
              ( arg( "transformation_matrix" ) ) )
        .def( "retrieveTranslation", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getTranslate )
        .def( "retrieveScaling", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getScale )
        .def( "retrieveMatrix", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getMatrix )
        .def( "isTranslationOperation", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isTranslateOp )
        .def( "isScalingOperation", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isScaleOp )
        .def( "isMatrixOperation", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isMatrixOp )
        ;
}

// Custom type trait to check if T can be converted to any integer type
// while excluding character and boolean types
template <typename T>
struct is_integer_convertible : boost::mpl::and_<
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, bool>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, char>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, unsigned char>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, signed char>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, wchar_t>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, char16_t>>,
    boost::mpl::not_<std::is_same<T, char32_t>>,
    boost::mpl::or_<
        boost::is_convertible<T, int>,
        boost::is_convertible<T, unsigned int>,
        boost::is_convertible<T, long>,
        boost::is_convertible<T, unsigned long>,
        boost::is_convertible<T, long long>,
        boost::is_convertible<T, unsigned long long>
    >
> {};

template<typename T>
IGL_INLINE void igl::svd3x3(const Eigen::Matrix<T, 3, 3>& input,
                            Eigen::Matrix<T, 3, 3>& left_vecs,
                            Eigen::Matrix<T, 3, 1>& singular_vals,
                            Eigen::Matrix<T, 3, 3>& right_vecs)
{
    // This variant strictly uses scalar operations — no vectorized instructions allowed
#include "Singular_Value_Decomposition_Kernel_Declarations.hpp"

    // Load input matrix entries into local scalar variables
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(Sa11.f = input(0,0);)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(Sa21.f = input(1,0);)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(Sa31.f = input(2,0);)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(Sa12.f = input(0,1);)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(Sa22.f = input(1,1);)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(Sa32.f = input(2,1);)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(Sa13.f = input(0,2);)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(Sa23.f = input(1,2);)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(Sa33.f = input(2,2);)

#include "Singular_Value_Decomposition_Main_Kernel_Body.hpp"

    // Store results back to output matrices and singular value vector
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(left_vecs(0,0) = Su11.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(left_vecs(1,0) = Su21.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(left_vecs(2,0) = Su31.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(left_vecs(0,1) = Su12.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(left_vecs(1,1) = Su22.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(left_vecs(2,1) = Su32.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(left_vecs(0,2) = Su13.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(left_vecs(1,2) = Su23.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(left_vecs(2,2) = Su33.f;)

    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(right_vecs(0,0) = Sv11.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(right_vecs(1,0) = Sv21.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(right_vecs(2,0) = Sv31.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(right_vecs(0,1) = Sv12.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(right_vecs(1,1) = Sv22.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(right_vecs(2,1) = Sv32.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(right_vecs(0,2) = Sv13.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(right_vecs(1,2) = Sv23.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(right_vecs(2,2) = Sv33.f;)

    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(singular_vals(0,0) = Sa11.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(singular_vals(1,0) = Sa22.f;)
    ENABLE_SCALAR_IMPLEMENTATION(singular_vals(2,0) = Sa33.f;)
}

#pragma runtime_checks("u", restore)

//-*****************************************************************************
void register_filmbackxformop()
{
    // FilmBackXformOp
    //
    class_<AbcG::FilmBackXformOp>(
          "FilmBackXformOp",
          "This class stores information about a specific transformation operation, "
          "without containing the actual data needed to compute a 3x3 matrix. "
          "It records the operation type (Translate, Scale, Matrix), an optional "
          "application-specific hint (e.g., for Maya), and flags indicating which "
          "aspects may vary over time.",
         init<const AbcG::FilmBackXformOperationType, const std::string&>(
             ( arg( "type" ), arg( "hint" ) = "" ),
             "Constructs a FilmBackXformOp initialized with the given operation type "
             "and optional hint string for application-specific interpretation." ) )
        .def( init<>("Default constructor creates an uninitialized FilmBackXformOp" ) )
        .def( "getType",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getType,
              "Returns the kind of transformation: Translate, Scale, or Matrix." )
        .def( "getHint",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getHint,
              "Returns the hint string used to distinguish between similar operation types." )
        .def( "getTypeHint",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getTypeHint,
              "Returns a combined string where the first character indicates the type "
              "('t', 's', or 'm') followed by the optional hint suffix." )
        .def( "getNumChannels",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getNumChannels,
              "Returns the count of scalar components: 2 for Translate/Scale, 9 for Matrix." )
        .def( "getChannelValue", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getChannelValue,
              ( arg( "index" ) ),
              "Retrieves the value at the specified channel index; returns 0 if out of bounds." )
        .def( "setChannelValue",
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setChannelValue,
              ( arg( "index" ), arg( "value" ) ),
              "Assigns a value to the given channel; no action taken if index exceeds capacity." )
        .def( "setTranslate", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setTranslate,
              ( arg( "translation" ) ) )
        .def( "setScale", 
              &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setScale,
              ( arg( "scaling" ) ) )
        .def( "setMatrix", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::setMatrix,
              ( arg( "mat" ) ) )
        .def( "getTranslate", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getTranslate )
        .def( "getScale", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getScale )
        .def( "getMatrix", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::getMatrix )
        .def( "isTranslateOp", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isTranslateOp )
        .def( "isScaleOp", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isScaleOp )
        .def( "isMatrixOp", &AbcG::FilmBackXformOp::isMatrixOp )
        ;
}
